void.$description: Void — Page canvas, full-bleed section backgrounds, dark product-demo interiors

near-black.$description: Near Black — Subtle recessed surface and dark overlay layer

carbon.$description: Carbon — Raised dark controls, prompt-composer depth, subdued surface detail

graphite.$description: Graphite — Secondary dark surface fills and inactive internal UI detail

ash.$description: Ash — Low-emphasis metadata, tiny helper copy, and quiet interface marks

steel.$description: Steel — Muted labels, inactive controls, and secondary icon strokes

fog.$description: Fog — Supporting body copy and descriptive text on black

silver.$description: Silver — Navigation text, higher-emphasis secondary copy, and fine strokes

white.$description: White — Headlines, button labels, prominent UI text, borders, and logo marks

signal-orange.$description: Signal Orange — Filled conversion buttons and circular submit controls — a concentrated warm interruption against Void

ember.$description: Ember — Orange hover treatment, active link fill, and thin warm inset highlight

burnt-orange.$description: Burnt Orange — Warm product-preview card fill and contained campaign-art surface

electric-yellow.$description: Electric Yellow — Orange-button glow, bright decorative borders, and vivid campaign-art accents

vector-green.$description: Vector Green — Sweeping decorative strokes and gradient-led editorial emphasis; Decorative line treatment, highlighted headline underlines, and expressive graphic strokes

inter.$description: Dense interface system for navigation, prompt text, buttons, metadata, product-demo controls, and body copy. Tight small labels may use expanded tracking, while normal body and navigation copy stays untracked.

acidgrotesk.$description: Display and section-heading family. Weight 400 keeps large statements open and conversational rather than heavy; use its 34px treatment for compact hero statements and 45px for editorial section lines.

acidgrotesksubset.$description: Supporting brand copy in footer links, compact UI labels, and small explanatory text; it keeps utility text visually related to the expressive display face.

system-ui.$description: system-ui — detected in extracted data but not described by AI
